# Tedca Corp

> AI automation agency that builds systems to run your business 24/7.

## What We Do

Tedca Corp builds AI-powered business automation for small and medium businesses. We specialize in three areas:

### Voice AI Receptionist
AI phone agent that answers calls, books appointments, qualifies leads, and integrates with Google Calendar, Outlook, and CRMs. Handles after-hours calls, reduces no-shows, and converts missed calls into revenue. Plans start at $500/month.

### AI Automation
Pre-built automation workflows including AI chatbots, automated follow-up emails, AI lead scoring, WhatsApp AI agents, and automatic email reply systems. Each automation runs autonomously and integrates with existing business tools.

### Claude Code Skills
Developer tools that plug into Claude Code (Anthropic's CLI). One-time purchase ($50), no subscription. Available skills:

- **Motion Graphic Video Creation**: Give it a topic. Returns a fully produced video with script, AI narration (ElevenLabs), sound effects, and rendered output. No editing needed.
- **Lead Generation Pipeline**: Give it an industry and location. Scrapes Google Maps, finds business owner emails, deduplicates, and delivers a clean Google Sheet ready for outreach.

## Key Facts

- Founded: 2025
- Location: United States
- Clients: 50+ businesses using Tedca automations
- Voice AI: 91% of callers can't tell it's AI
- Skills: Instant delivery via Stripe, no recurring fees
- Tech stack: Claude Code, Anthropic, OpenRouter, ElevenLabs, Remotion, Apify, Google Sheets
